Each transfer updates `lastTx[victim]` to the current block timestamp. This prevents the victim from initiating any transactions of their own, as the check `require(lastTx[sender].add(60) <= block.timestamp)` (where the victim is the `sender`) will continuously fail, effectively denying them service.
